, USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{siteCd} , #{schCd} , #{schNo} , #{schType} , REPLACE(#{applyDate}, '-', '')

, IFNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y') , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SCH_NO = NEW.SCH_NO , SCH_TYPE = NEW.SCH_TYPE , APPLY_DATE = NEW.APPLY_DATE

/* Attd01Mapper.selectSchHistList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.HIST_IDX AS histIdx , A.SCH_CD AS schCd , DATE_FORMAT(A.APPLY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS applyDate
, CONCAT( A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME , '-' , A.FST_SCH_END_TIME ) AS fstSchTime , A.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN AS fstSchBrkMin
, CONCAT( A.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , '-' , A.SEC_SCH_END_TIME ) AS secSchTime , A.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN AS secSchBrkMin
, A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.INSERT_NO AS userId , B.USER_NM AS userNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS insertDate FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST A INNER JOIN TB_USER B ON ( A.INSERT_NO = B.USER_ID ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.SCH_CD = #{schCd} ORDER BY A.CMPNY_CD, A.SITE_CD, A.HIST_IDX

/* Attd01Mapper.selectShiftTypeInfoList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SHIFT_CD AS shiftCd , A.SHIFT_NO AS shiftNo , A.SHIFT_PTRN_CNT AS shiftPtrnCnt , A.SHIFT_TEAM_CNT AS shiftTeamCnt , A.SHIFT_CYCLE_DAYS AS shiftCycleDays , A.USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_SHIFT_SCH_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.SHIFT_CD = #{shiftCd}
